document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
after: You do NOT need to write any addresses.

text: How are you? I just had to tell you about the amazing day I had last Saturday – I joined a group of volunteers cleaning up the beach at Seal Bay!

There were about thirty of us, and we spent the whole morning picking up rubbish along the shore. You wouldn’t believe how much we found: plastic bottles, fishing nets, even an old bicycle! By lunchtime, we’d filled over fifty bags, and the beach looked completely different.

It was hard work, but I loved it. It felt great to do something useful for a change, and I met some really friendly people, including a marine biologist who told us all about the seals that live there.

They’re organising another clean-up on 18 July, and I immediately thought of you, since you love the sea so much. Why don’t you come with me? They provide gloves and bags, so you’d just need to bring some water and a hat. We could grab some fish and chips afterwards!
Let me know if you can make it. I really hope you can!

note.en: Adds surprise: they even found a bicycle.
Sets the time of the result.
A contrast: hard work, but enjoyable.
Singles out one person from the group.
Here since = because: why she thought of her friend.
note.kk: Мұнда since = because: неге досын ойлады.
note.ru: Здесь since = because: почему подумала о друге.

note.en: A consequence: everything is provided, so little is needed.
note.kk: Салдары: бәрін береді — көп нәрсе алудың қажеті жоқ.
note.ru: Следствие: всё выдают — брать почти ничего не нужно.

strengths.en: Bottles, nets, a bicycle and fifty bags make the story easy to picture.
strengths.kk: Бөтелкелер, торлар, велосипед, елу қап — оқиғаны елестету оңай.
strengths.ru: Бутылки, сети, велосипед, пятьдесят мешков — рассказ легко представить.

strengths.en: Contractions, exclamations and “You wouldn’t believe” are conversational but correct.
strengths.kk: Қысқартулар, лепті сөйлемдер, «You wouldn’t believe» — ауызекі, бірақ сауатты.
strengths.ru: Сокращения, восклицания, «You wouldn’t believe» — разговорно, но грамотно.
strengths.example: You wouldn’t believe how much we found

strengths.en: A date, a reason and what to bring make it easy to say yes.
strengths.kk: Күні, себебі және не алу керек — досқа келісу оңай.
strengths.ru: Дата, причина и что взять — другу легко согласиться.
strengths.example: Why don’t you come with me?

strengths.en: “By lunchtime, we’d filled” is past perfect used correctly in an informal letter.
strengths.kk: «By lunchtime, we’d filled» — бейресми хатта орынды past perfect.
strengths.ru: «By lunchtime, we’d filled» — past perfect к месту в неформальном письме.
strengths.example: By lunchtime, we’d filled over fifty bags

note.en: A friend, by first name: informal.
A greeting question and the main news with an exclamation.
note.kk: Амандасу сұрағы және лепті сөйлеммен басты жаңалық.
note.ru: Вопрос-приветствие и главная новость с восклицанием.

note.en: Bullet 1: what they did — numbers and vivid details (even a bicycle!).
note.kk: 1-тармақ — не істеді: сандар және айқын деректер (тіпті велосипед!).
note.ru: Пункт 1 — что делали: числа и яркие детали (даже велосипед!).

note.en: Bullet 2: feelings and what was enjoyable.
Bullet 3: an invitation with a date, a reason and practical tips.
note.kk: 3-тармақ — күні, себебі және практикалық кеңестері бар шақыру.
note.ru: Пункт 3 — приглашение с датой, причиной и практическими советами.

note.en: A short request for a reply.
“Take care” is a warm informal sign-off.

document.title: A beach clean-up with volunteers
bullets: say how you felt about it
invite your friend to join you next time
document.question:

Write a letter to a friend. In your letter
